title: Days of Elijah
lyrics_original: These are the days of Elijah,
Declaring the word of the Lord:
And these are the days of Your servant Moses,
Righteousness being restored.
And though these are days of great trial,
Of famine and darkness and sword,
Still, we are the voice in the desert crying
'Prepare ye the way of the Lord!'
Behold He comes, riding on the clouds
Shining like the sun, at the trumpet call!
Lift your voice, it's the year of jubilee
And out of Zion's hill salvation comes!
These are the days of Ezekiel,
The dry bones becoming as flesh.
And these are the days of Your servant David,
Rebuilding a temple of praise.
These are the days of the harvest,
The fields are as white in Your world!
And we are the laborers in Your vineyard,
Declaring the word of the Lord!
Behold He comes, riding on the clouds
Shining like the sun, at the trumpet call!
Lift your voice, it's the year of jubilee
And out of Zion's hill salvation comes!
There is no God like Jehovah.
There is no God like Jehovah!
There is no God like Jehovah.
There is no God like Jehovah!
There is no God like Jehovah.

bible_verses.english: “Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and dreadful day of Yahweh comes.
The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for calling me to be a voice of hope and truth in this generation. Give me the courage to stand firm in faith, even when the world around me feels uncertain. Fill my heart with the joy of Your salvation and the vibrant hope of Your coming glory. May my life and my praise prepare a path for Your love to transform hearts today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Even in seasons of uncertainty or trial, God calls us to stand as bold messengers of His enduring truth and hope. Like the prophets of old, we are invited to declare His righteousness and make space for His light in a weary world. As we look forward to the glorious return of Jesus, our hearts are anchored in the joyous promise of His ultimate victory. Today, let us raise our voices with confidence, eagerly celebrating the King who brings restoration and freedom.
